about_the_game:
In an alternate reality, a corporation that has subjugated most of the planet has wiped an ancient city off the face of the earth in order to extract a rare isotope. Twenty years later, one of the few survivors returns. Now he is the leader of a guerrilla group, ready to unite scattered clans to reclaim his homeland and take revenge.

Use instant strikes, dashes, and tactical Rewind to correct mistakes and survive in battle. Plan raids from the hub, upgrade implants and equipment, and then disrupt the corporation's plans in fierce raids where every mistake costs lives.

Features:

  • Lightning-fast gameplay built around the one-hit kill mechanic.

  • Unique Rewind ability — bend time to rewrite the fight.

  • A striking cyberfolk world mixing Slavic folklore with cyberpunk aesthetics.

  • Deep implant system unlocking new combat mechanics and tactical options.

  • Interactive hub with NPCs for raid preparation, upgrades, and lore discovery.

  • Atmospheric soundtrack blending neofolk, darkwave, and gritty guitar riffs.
